item.title: Show HN: Emd – Fast EDA's for CSV and XLS(X) from the Terminal
item.summary: emd is an open-source Python CLI for quickly exploring CSV and Excel datasets from the terminal. It generates Markdown reports and charts, with built-in data quality checks, statistical analysis, dataset comparison, diagnostics, and health scoring.
